review_prompt: Choose the kinds of Aha! records to remember on this Aha! account.

types.label: Aha! features
types.description: Each Aha! Roadmaps feature becomes one artifact keyed by its reference number, however it was opened: the record page or its Aha! Develop form.

vectors.why: leading key differs from the path, so entry 1 does not apply
vectors.title: OPS-2 rollout | Aha!

vectors.why: no entry matches; whole title kept
vectors.title: Untitled tab

vectors.why: route word is not a jira_key
rewritten from a different-host negative (other.aha.io): on the family's own permissive subdomain origin, the host just becomes part of the ID
KNOWN LIMIT: a login tab's title on a record URL is recorded whole until the real title loads
vectors.title: Log in to your workspace | Aha!

types.label: Aha! requirements
types.description: Each requirement becomes one artifact keyed by its own reference number, kept separate from its parent feature, however it was opened: the record page or its Aha! Develop form.

types.label: Aha! epics
types.description: Each epic becomes one artifact keyed by its reference number, however it was opened: the record page or its Aha! Develop form.

types.label: Aha! releases
types.description: Each release (or schedule, in a non-product workspace) becomes one artifact keyed by its reference number.

types.label: Aha! ideas
types.description: Each idea opened inside the Aha! application becomes one artifact keyed by its reference number, however it was opened: the record page or its Aha! Develop form. The same idea opened on an ideas portal is a separate artifact (Aha! portal ideas).

types.label: Aha! notes
types.description: Each Aha! Notes or Knowledge document (a "page") becomes one artifact keyed by its reference number, however it was opened, including a workspace-scoped link that survives a move between workspaces.

vectors.why: the workspace segment is skipped, so a moved note keeps its ID
known limit: internal numeric note id records a separate artifact
